contact.title: Contact Us
contact.intro: The Wira team is here to help. Pick whichever channel suits you:

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.s1_body: By downloading, installing and using the Wira application (the "App"), you confirm that you have read, understood and agreed to these Terms & Conditions. This document forms a binding agreement between you and Wira.
terms.s2_body: Wira provides a platform that connects you with independent service providers — driver partners, merchant partners and service partners — for transport, food delivery, parcel delivery and other services.
terms.s3_body: You need an account to use the App. You are responsible for keeping your account details, including your password, confidential. Everything done through your account is your responsibility.
terms.s4_body: You can pay in cash or with your WiraPay balance. WiraPay top-ups are made via QRIS or a third-party payment provider connected to Wira. All transactions are in Indonesian Rupiah (IDR).
terms.s5_body: Wira is not liable for direct or indirect losses arising from your use of, or inability to use, our services, including but not limited to delivery delays or the conduct of a partner.

refund.title: Refund Policy
refund.s1_body: Wira is committed to keeping your balance safe. WiraPay refunds are available in certain situations, set out below.
refund.s2_item_1: If an order (WiraRide, WiraFood or WiraSend) is cancelled before a partner accepts it, your WiraPay balance is returned in full, immediately.
refund.s2_item_2: If a partner cancels the order, your balance is returned in full.
refund.s2_item_3: If you cancel after a partner is already on the way to you, a cancellation fee may be charged to compensate the partner.
refund.s3_body: If your WiraPay balance is deducted because of a system error or activity you didn't authorise, request a refund through Contact Us within 7 days of it happening. We investigate within one to three working days.
refund.s4_body: Customer WiraPay balances can't currently be withdrawn to a personal bank account. Your balance can only be spent inside the Wira app.
